Name: Crate As Pots
Author: BethKitten
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=5]Redesigned Crate Garden pots in various colors for your farm.

I took the crate decoration from crafting and turned it in to a garden pot. There are nine different colors to choose from.

This is a Content Patcher mod so it should work with every game version so long as you have the Content Patcher mod installed.To use this mod simply download and unzip to your mods folder. Should there be any issues or if you want another color please make a post in the post section of this mod.
[/size][/font]

[font=Georgia][size=5]
